name: Hash without Sine
notes:
David Hoskins, [Shadertoy 4djSRW](https://www.shadertoy.com/view/4djSRW), MIT, Copyright (c) 2014 David Hoskins.

The complete Hoskins notice in `NOTICE` was verified against the [WGSL port by David A Roberts, pinned revision f3619046](https://gist.github.com/davidar/5f9677a0ccfbd63d7a8657ad9af3a856/f3619046080c1f8ff07c54f6658ed215ef5f9638). The original Shadertoy page could not be fetched. No WGSL implementation was copied, and its separate port copyright does not describe these Metal adaptations. There are no imported implementation originals.

Used by `shared/common.metal` and standalone hashes in Matrix Corridor, Fireworks, Ember Drift, Sunlit Shallows, Voronoi, Rune Glyph and Ember Sparks. Copy the complete notice with each adaptation.
requirements: Floating-point fract arithmetic; no textures or extra uniforms
summary: David Hoskins hash functions used by canonical common helpers and standalone Metal adaptations.
